command:
POD=$(kubectl get pods -n kcm-system -l cluster.x-k8s.io/provider=infrastructure-aws -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}'); COUNT=$(kubectl logs -n kcm-system "$POD" | grep -c 'AuthFailure\|RequestExpired' || echo 0); printf 'Captured count: <%s>
' "$COUNT"; kubectl get clustertemplate aws-standalone-cp-1-0-26 -n kcm-system -o jsonpath='{.status.config.controlPlane.instanceType}{"
"}{.status.config.k0s.version}{"
"}'; kubectl get credential aws-cluster-identity-cred -n kcm-system -o jsonpath='{.status}'
